message.content: {"evidence":"The U-component shows a large positive offset at J1 (≈+14.8) followed by a near-equal negative offset at J3 (≈−14.7) with intermediate observations (e.g., indices 571–596) remaining elevated relative to pre-J1 levels, supporting a temporary displacement interval [534,596] that returns near baseline at J3; J2’s large N/E offsets are inconsistent with a simple return and appear independent.","pair_ids":["P2"]}
